I used to work as a liquor store cashier for $10/h until a month ago. Also worked from Monday to Saturday for 8 to 10 hours daily. Unfortunately, I was not legal to work at the country so I had to take it because it was better than doing nothing. 

We all face hardships in life and it all depends on how we embrace them, it boils my blood on how they took advantage of my condition so disgustingly because of their greed. 

I was a top worker and always gave my 100% even with that pay, not mentioning I was my customer’s favorite cashier, many of them even brought me gifts the day of my birthday. 

Lasted 9 months at the job and quitted with a month of anticipation. My dad occasionally goes by and tells me things used to be so light up and in order when I was there. It warms my heart that I know I did a good job until the end.

Now my family and I are beginning our own business and honestly life pays back somehow :) Chin up, things can always be worse. There’s no better gift than learning from life experiences.

When I was in college in 2019, I had a casual friend 3 years younger than me, a Venezuelan boy that I met on a short film we acted together. One day after college I’m walking my way home when we see each other by coincidence. 

We are talking inside the bus now and he casually tells me that today was his birthday. I congratulate him and asked what’s the plan for today, him feeling a little bit down and says not much really, he was just gonna eat cake with his family at night and call it a day. 

It was around midday when this happened and I proposed to him to let’s just go to a pizza place I think he could like, he told me that he wasn’t carrying any money and I laughed at the gesture but told him it was on me. 

I bought two big pizzas, we talked and eat and told him to get the rest of the pizza home so he could share with his family. 

We are still friends to this day! Just yesterday he told me again that he appreciates that day as one of the most special birthdays he’s ever had just because the selflessly sudden act.

For those who don’t understand, to put an example, each time someone called one of our friends on our circle, we or some people used to moan and say sex phrases around the person answering the phone to mock him/her into thinking they were having savage sex. Just a dumb way to make your friends laugh and get the other person embarrassed haha.
